narrative:
## Handover Summary — Traffic & Volume Forecast

Volumes are approved by product and market with bi-monthly checkpoints.

## Key Decisions
• WhatsApp Business volume lifted on template migration
• International OTP front-loaded for Q1 marketplace launches
• Norway campaign SMS stepped down -6% for channel cannibalisation

## Recommendation for Carrier & Termination Cost
Use the approved volumes to renegotiate operator volume tiers and size direct binds — Central Europe Enterprise SMS is close to the next price tier.

## Risk Factors
• Seasonal Black Friday / Christmas OTP peaks
• AIT-inflated OTP volume may overstate genuine demand

signals.title: Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) on OTP routes
signals.excerpt: Pumping attacks detected on 9 premium international destinations; ~3% of OTP termination cost is non-converting.
